summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, attaching a press release announcing preliminary second quarter 2026 operating results. The release details gold production of 97,429 ounces in Q2 and 193,445 ounces in the first half, with AISC expected below $2,200/oz and a realized gold price of ~$4,380/oz. Cash balances are estimated at $190 million. It also provides an update on ongoing operational improvements and development at the Kurmuk Mine, expected to start operations in August. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation event.
